Research Areas



Virome Ecology
Understanding how viruses shape ecological communities across natural and agricultural systems.



Plant Virology
Discovering, characterizing, and tracking plant viruses using genomics and molecular biology.



Bioinformatics
Developing reproducible computational methods for sequence analysis and pathogen discovery.






Disease Ecology
Studying pathogen dynamics across hosts, landscapes, and ecosystems.



Microbiome Ecology
Investigating interactions among viruses, fungi, bacteria, oomycetes, nematodes, and plants.



Forest Pathology
Understanding emerging diseases affecting forest ecosystems through ecology and genomics.
